Q: A bind socket request gives a EADDRNOTAVAIL A:

You are trying to bind your socket to a non-local IP address.

You don't generally need to bind to a specific IP address at all. Change:

sockaddr.sin_addr.s_addr = inet_addr(ip);

to

sockaddr.sin_addr.s_addr = INADDR_ANY;

Q: Modify pdf text objects on linux A:

  • The language could be linux shell, Python, C, C++ (the ones I know) ... unless there is something really magic in another language I can quickly learn

  • I would like to change the displayed colors, but I understand that it can be tricky for pdf with many blend modes etc. But I think changing at the level of drawing instructions would be enough for most of them.

  • In the example of a blue path covering a red text :

    • Blue path should be converted to white, and red text yo black, so at the end white path covering should cover a black text

  • About the gradient ... mmh ... the perfect way should be that the red half of the text is converted to gray gradient and that the blue disappears. But I mostly hope that there would be no gradients.

For a little bit of context, what I want to do is color separation for RISOH printing ( it's a printer that use 2 masters (or more) to print each of the colors with successive layers). If a pdf file has 2 colors (let's say red and blue), then I need to send to the printer :

  • A pdf file showing only red items, but in black (or gray gradient)

  • A pdf file showing only blue items, but in black (or gray gradient)

There is already something that achieve color separation for images, that I can use for all images of a pdf, and then use ghostscript to replace it inside the pdf. So it only remains texts and paths.

Q: Extract certificate (.cer) from installer programmatically A:

Try Get-AuthenticodeSignature

You can run Get-AuthenticodeSignature cmdlet to retrieve Authenticode signing certificate from MSI.

SignerCertificate:

Get-AuthenticodeSignature -FilePath 'myinstaller.msi' | 
    Select-Object -ExpandProperty authenticode | 
    Export-Certificate -FilePath SignerCertificate.crt

TimeStamperCertificate:

Get-AuthenticodeSignature -FilePath 'myinstaller.msi' |
    Select-Object -ExpandProperty TimeStamperCertificate | 
    Export-Certificate -FilePath TimeStamperCertificate.crt
